needed.suggestion: Construct a proper sidewalk for safer pedestrian access.
Remove obstacles to improve sidewalk usability.
Repair uneven sections to prevent tripping.
Install a refuge island to improve crossing safety.
Mark a pedestrian crossing to alert drivers.
